title: Reading Drill — Testing screen brightness at an exhibition — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing screen brightness at an exhibition — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Ravensmere began with reports of labels becoming difficult to read beside large windows. The exhibition technician had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using short visitor trials and chose the proportion of labels read correctly as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a matt screen cover. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted ten weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded clouds changing rapidly as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
